games.name: Shinobi Reborn
games.desc:
A new era of ninjas has begun. Train, fight, and awaken your true power in a world inspired by Naruto Shippuden.

- Explore vast villages and hidden lands
- Unlock powerful clans and unique Kekkei Genkai
- Engage in PVP and PVE to unlock greater abilities and become stronger.

CONTROLS (💻) 
W + W = Sprint
Q = Dash
F = Block
R = Substitute
E = Throwable
V = Carry
B = Execute
G = Activate Clan Mode
H = Activate Sub Mode
C = Clan Mode (Spec 1)
F + C = Clan Mode (Spec 2)
Z = Sub Mode (Spec 1)
F + Z = Sub Mode (Spec 2)
M = Menu
` = Inventory

CONTROLS (🎮)
X- Attack
B- Dash
Y- Sub
LT - Block
Left Stick - Sprint
RT + X - Weapon
Hold LT + RT + press LS - Shiftlock
Dpad down - Grip
LT + Dpad Left - Clan Mode 
LB + Dpad Left - Clan Spec 1
RT + Dpad Left - Sub Mode 
RB + Dpad Left - Sub Mode Spec 1
LB + RB - Skill Selection
RB - Skill Scroll Left
LB - Skill Scroll Right
RT - execute skills when selected

Starter Code:
WELCOME

games.name: Endless Escape
games.desc:
🏃‍♂️ Endless Escape - Run, Survive, Escape!
A monster is hunting you! Work together, stay connected, and survive the never-ending obby. Can you outrun the Noob and set a new record?

🔥 How to Play:
✔ Stay Connected - Stick with your team or risk falling behind!
✔ Escape the Noob - If he catches you, it’s game over!
✔ Endless Stages - 40+ unique obstacles that progress upwards and are randomized every run!
✔ Checkpoints & Revives - All Players must step on a pad to progress. If you die, teammates can revive you!
✔ Earn Coins - Progress through stages to collect coins for the upcoming shop!

🎮 Mobile shift lock supported!
👍 Like & Favorite for updates!

📈 The higher you reach, the more difficult the game gets, good luck!
